title: Mary Had a Little Lamb with Lulu | Nursery Rhyme for Kids
description:
Sing along to Mary Had a Little Lamb! Mary and her fluffy little lamb play in a sunny meadow. The lamb hops, soft snowflakes drift by, and Lulu the duck and Bunny come to join in.

A classic nursery rhyme (words by Sarah Josepha Hale, 1830; traditional tune) for children aged 2 to 6.
